humor_and_voices: Opening ribbon entitlement and the one-line temporary-arrangement reply establish Neet immediately. His tunnel literalism, retreat from Shadow distance measurement and muffled rope orders vary the joke mechanisms.

Buddy has a clear independent want to finish without explanations. His first-thought reply, stopping on the beam, fetch temptation and prudent refusal to release the rope give him actions and small absurdities, not just commentary.
Heather participates through bandana care, the wet-match callback and gentle retrieval of Buddy from the fetch line; her affectionate practicality stays distinct from both dogs.
causality_and_payoff: Buddy seeing tunnel daylight precedes attempting it; completed tunnel supplies his own reasoning for entering the pool. Neet silence has an immediate observable consequence when Buddy steps again.
All four events progress coherently: obstacle course together, Shadow long jump, Chikki fetch, gang tug-of-war. Ribbon award follows results. Shade and muddy paws resolve Buddy effort.

Neet standing to discuss training is followed by his decision to lie down; the undefeated-ribbons final line callbacks the opening ambition while allowing shared rest. The illustration precedes rather than contradicts this final change.
image_placement_and_continuity: Setup follows Buddy looking at water: dry matching gray bandanas, chin-up Neet, bowl-focused Buddy and park bunting. No later prize or dirt spoils the progression.
Beam image follows forced silence and precedes pool: dirt-specked Buddy nose, cautious reaching forepaw, closed-mouth waiting Neet and matching dry bandanas preserve the exact state.

Closing picture follows Heather setting ribbons beside resting Buddy and Neet opening his mouth; mud on extended paws, wet bandana patches, two grass-level ribbons and banyan shade agree with prose. Neet still stands because the next paragraph is his lie-down.
observations.complementarity: Three distinct contributions: visual conflict of intentions before competition, physical concentration and restrained leadership mid-course, then tired satisfaction against renewed training ambition. Different spatial arrangements and standing/resting states avoid portrait repetition. Embedded spacing keeps dialogue attribution intact and allows the final sentence its own space.
